question: How do the Rudras dwell within the many cavities of maya?
premises: The cavities are covered by subtle layers and walls of maya.
Because of this covering, they are invisible to one another.
Countless happy Rudras dwell in each cavity.
inference: Maya partitions its cavities so that innumerable Rudras dwell separately and happily within them.
plain_english: Covered by subtle layers and walls of maya, invisible to one another, countless happy Rudras dwell there in each cavity.
